property_summary: After an attacker deposits amount v1 and then withdraws, the reentrancy lock guarantees the final stored balance equals exactly v1 for every input (the re-entrant add during withdrawal reverts); the mutant, lacking nonReentrant_, lets the re-entrant add succeed so the balance ends at 0 instead of v1.
change_summary: Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier from addToBalance so reentrant calls can add to balances, changing stored userBalance values.
